verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is a terminal coding agent, so automatic PR review is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows only a headless mode that is "safe to embed in CI scripts." That is a building block a developer could wire into a pipeline themselves, not a documented PR-review capability. Nothing in the pack describes triggering on pull requests or posting contextual review feedback.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request
